# Issue #011: Link Clicking and Interactive Element Testing

## Description
Implement comprehensive tests for interacting with page elements including clicking links, filling forms, and selecting dropdown options.

## Requirements
- Create a test script that identifies and clicks links on a page
- Implement form filling test with multiple input types
- Test dropdown selection functionality
- Verify that interactions result in expected page changes
- Handle dynamically loaded content with appropriate waiting strategies
- Test hover interactions and menu navigation

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test script successfully clicks links and verifies navigation
- [ ] Form inputs are filled with test data correctly
- [ ] Dropdown selections work as expected
- [ ] Dynamic content loading after interactions is properly handled
- [ ] Hover interactions trigger expected UI changes
- [ ] All interactions are verified with appropriate assertions

## Technical Implementation
Create a new test script (`test-interactions.js`) that focuses on page element interactions with appropriate waiting mechanisms for dynamic content.

## Related Components
- src/puppeteer.ts (click, fill, hover, and select functions)
- src/browser-manager.ts
- tests/test-browser.js (extend this approach)
